title: ONE CLICK INSTANT MINE ORES
script:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local UsePickaxe = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("UsePickaxe")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local mouse = player:GetMouse()
local oreParent = workspace:WaitForChild("Ores")

local function isOre(part)
	return part:IsDescendantOf(oreParent)
end

mouse.Button1Down:Connect(function()
	local target = mouse.Target
	if target and isOre(target) then
		local oreCFrame = target.CFrame
		for i = 1, 20 do
			UsePickaxe:InvokeServer(oreCFrame)
			task.wait()
		end
	end
end)
